label: Whatever has represented esse equal to its essence has its own existence in its nature
paraphrase: OPEN (unconditional essentialism's reading of esse = essence), analyst formulation: for every being x whose represented esse equals its represented essence (the q.3 a.4 essenceOf/esseOf maps), it lies in the nature of x (Essential) that x exists, unconditionally: the proposition true exactly at the points where x exists. The bridge from the essence-esse identity to an essential truth; existence-conditional essentialism rejects it for any such being whose absence is representable (controls, law 3).
